scientific_integrity: Proof uses explicit covariance, a Gaussian folded-product identity, and strict convexity of a derivative numerator. Finite checks are supplementary. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact optimizer is for the leading matched-reference variance coefficient and a reflection-symmetric three-bin family with fixed positive masses; no finite-N or unrestricted-simplex optimum is claimed. Priority against obscure historical optimization results remains a residual risk.
title: Two turning points and the sharp noise-variance optimizer for reflection-symmetric three-bin histograms
